title: Setup accepts a long PATH and pushes the onboarding branch with the install's own push credential
description: A fixture host with a 1,500-character PATH: the registry proposal the accounts step runs applies, and the pinned runtime keeps the whole PATH led by the resolved install directory; a 9,000-character value is refused naming PATH and its exact length. The onboarding branch push lands on a fixture git remote whose SSH door serves git only to the install's deploy key — the credential the merge writer itself pushes with, never the operator's personal SSH key.
